note_tweet.text:
百度带来一款全新的开源模型
文心 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base

这是一个供开发者继续训练的 AI 底座模型，开发者可以在它上面继续训练，打造自己或者行业专属 AI 模型

特点是知识面广、能处理长内容，同时节省计算资源

从零开始预训练
2800 亿参数
运行时只激活约 140 亿（5%）
支持 100 万 token 上下文

它的价值是：提供了一个可以继续定制的起点：加入行业知识、适配本地语言，再结合后续训练和产品开发，就能做成适合自己业务的 AI

创新点

1. 长文用两种方式读：ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base把上下文的 KV 缓存 43 层分成两组：37 层看压缩后的内容，保留全局信息；另外 6 层可以回到原文，挑出相关的位置仔细看。这样既省缓存，又能找长文里的具体细节

2. 选专家，从一个人拍板变成多人打分：每次还是从 512 个专家里挑 10 个，变化在于由多个“派单员”共同打分。专家的计算量一样，但选出来的专家更能帮上忙

3. 让最后一层多练一步：模型训练时，除了猜紧接着会出现什么，还可以练习猜再往后的内容，以往会专门加一个模块做这件事，ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base直接复用最后一层。到了实际生成时，这一层还能先拟出候选内容，再交给模型验证

训练机器人最大的痛点就是标注：

戴着运动相机拍第一人称视频容易，但要分清“哪只手在抓什么、手指弯了多少度、亚秒级的动作从哪一秒开始”非常困难…

目前一般使用顶尖大模型标，一小时视频烧掉 70 多刀

Perceptron 1.0 直接把这道门槛踹平了：

它能连 0.5 秒以内的瞬间抓放、拧转都能精准切分，精度咬死顶尖大模型

左右手各走各的时间轴，单独记录这只手抓着啥、那只手在干嘛，双臂机器人学协同不用再猜

免校准 3D 手势，手机随手拍的视频，不用填镜头参数，也能直接还原双手三维网格和关节动态

全套“动作线 + 双手标签 + 3D重建”一小时只要 29 刀，基础动作切分甚至只要 9 刀/小时，直砍到大模型的八分之一

直接提供自助接口，一次可以塞 1000 个视频批量跑…

data.text:
复杂度与画质解耦：API 新增 complexity 参数单独调控模型的规划投入，让简单修改和复杂画面分别选择合适的设置

SVG 矢量导出与 Codex 悬浮编辑：支持生成无限放大的矢量路径资产，Codex 内改图直接在画布悬浮层完成

详细内容：https://t.co/w1yOHk9Czi

围绕同一个角色反复创作时，人物的长相、发型和宠物的花纹都可能在修改中变化；每次重新上传参考图也很麻烦

ChatGPT Images 2.6 在产品端上线了固定参考图（Reference images）功能

你可以将本人照片、宠物、家人朋友、自创 IP 角色或特定场景空间保存为命名参考卡片，以后直接生成调用... https://t.co/wWroD8U292

通过提示词或图像可直接生成或者转化为动态 GIF

你还可以调整速度，编辑单个帧，并循环分享 https://t.co/ozyuBcma1M
低画质档位下，2.6 Flare 耗时从前代的 7.08 秒降至 4.84 秒 https://t.co/EfiLpTeQXP

note_tweet.text:
OpenAI 发布 Images 2.6 
能生成 GIF 图了

OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Images 2.6，并在 API 同步上线 GPT-Image-2.6 Flare 与 Sunburst 两款全新图像模型

核心升级为能做 GIF、存参考图，API 生成更快：

生成速度提升 50%：Flare 模型在低画质档位下最快 6 秒出图，大幅缩短创意原型等待时间

原生支持动图 GIF：用文字或图片做循环 GIF，可调节播放速度并针对单帧微调

固定参考图：个人面孔、宠物与固定角色一次保存即可持续引用，支持多角色同框组合创作

手绘标注局部重绘：开发者可直接在原图上画圈、打叉、标箭头或指定色块，模型可按标注修改，样例中的标记也被去除

note_tweet.text:
What I'm seeing across the industry right now is that the biggest bottleneck to AI adoption isn't model capabilities. It's data infrastructure.

Today, we're expanding the Eon Data Foundation with the launch of Eon Yukon, a new serverless data engine purposely built to change that.

AI agents need fresh, contextualized data to act. 
Specialized models need a continuous feed of data and feedback to improve. Both are still served by a stack, an architecture, and methods built for dashboards:

-Spark and Flink clusters sized for peak, plus compaction jobs to keep tables usable.

-A pipeline and a copy for every consumer, staged bronze to silver to gold.

-Hand-written jobs, wired together by an orchestrator and kept alive by specialists.

The result: shipping data is complicated, risky, and expensive. While coding agents ship apps in hours, they rarely build or run data pipelines. The data is too volatile, and a mistake costs too much.

With Yukon, data moves from ingestion to processing to serving in one continuous flow, without the infrastructure and pipelines traditionally required to connect them.

Events become compacted, sorted, deduplicated Iceberg tables within seconds.

Real-time aggregations run inline, with fully managed state. Agents and applications can access fresh data with sub-millisecond latency through a Redis-compatible API or through our SQL and spark compatible query engine.

Beyond moving and serving data, Yukon makes it continuously understandable - Live column-level statistics, accessible through MCP, give agents visibility into the data. Built-in monitoring, sampling, and data minimization help teams maintain control.

At 1M events/sec and equal freshness, Yukon used 4x less compute than Spark and 7x less than Flink. The benchmark is public: run it yourself with Eon’s ingest-bench.

This is another major step toward our vision of an Autonomous Data Foundation for the AI era, built to both protect enterprise data and unlock its full potential.

note_tweet.text:
细思极恐！REA仓库一夜爆火，Mika控制手机操作微信，我把剪映、飞书录音豆还有一大堆APP轻松逆向。

AI能力飞速发展带来的后果是——各家大厂App（包括微信）连忙关上口子、我也收到律师函😅。

我能深刻地感受到“AI安全”已经迫在眉睫。现在Codex和Claude Code已经能够让我这样的普通人开发出数千star的项目、也能让很多不懂代码的小白Vibe Coding出一大堆“产品”。

但是这些“产品”仍然是玩具——我们只会开发功能，从来不关心安全，或者说，不知道如何做好安全防守。很可能辛辛苦苦卖产品赚来的钱，还不够黑客打劫的。。。

现在，终于有人下场来认真做“AI安全”这件事了。GCSA（全球网络安全联盟）和华润隆地一起成立了 AI 与网络安全研究中心，宗旨就是 AI 反诈、威胁检测和安全自动化！

GSCA有一款专门进行安全审查的工具：https://t.co/w40DTeKZ8x，大家可以把GitHub仓库丢进去检查检查，可能会给你找出来很多潜在bug！避免掉很多损失！

如果是在用Codex的朋友，也强烈推荐去把Codex Security这个插件下载下来，给自己的项目一道保障。

China Resources Longdation's Aethereal Cybersecurity and GCSA Jointly Establish the Centre for AI and Cybersecurity Research

Hong Kong, November 4, 2026 — China Resources Longdation's Aethereal Cybersecurity and Global Cybersecurity Alliance Limited (GCSA) have announced the joint establishment of the Centre for AI and Cybersecurity Research. The initiative brings together both parties' technological expertise and industry resources in artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, and industrial applications to advance research, product innovation, and industry collaboration.

Founded in 1982, China Resources Longdation operates across property management, asset management, and community services. Its Aethereal Cybersecurity business specializes in AI-driven digital transformation and cybersecurity services for government agencies and enterprises, providing professional technologies and solutions to Hong Kong's government departments, public institutions, and businesses, supported by relevant cybersecurity qualifications. GCSA is committed to advancing technological innovation, research collaboration, and international exchange in cybersecurity, with a particular focus on emerging security challenges involving AI, Web3, and digital finance.

The two parties will strengthen their cooperation in cybersecurity. The Centre will focus on joint research and development in AI-powered fraud prevention, cyber threat detection, digital financial security, and cybersecurity automation. Key areas of exploration include AI deception honeypots, intelligent fraud detection, threat intelligence analysis, and security platforms, with an emphasis on practical applications.

By combining their respective resources and professional service capabilities, the partnership aims to foster cross-organizational collaboration in AI and cybersecurity, contributing to the development of the digital economy and cybersecurity industry.
